COMMUNITY

Cast announced for upcoming ACT production of “Frankenstein: The Radio Play”

ByLocal Sources September 23, 2026September 23, 2026 Reading Time: 2 minutes
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:41
Instaread

Actors Community Theatre Inc. (ACT) is proud to once again offer a horror-filled theatre experience ahead of the Halloween season with its production of Frankenstein: The Radio Play, taking place at the Thyen-Clark Cultural Center Black Box Theatre on October 8-10, 2026.

The ACT Board of Directors is excited to welcome back Kirsten Neukam as Production Coordinator and Andy Hoffman as Light/Sound Operator for this fall production.

The cast of Frankenstein: The Radio Play includes Alec Lechner, Jeff Graves, Bryce Conway, Seth Neukam, Cyrus Winkler, Arwen McClung, Lucy Dixon, Amanda Olive, Ellen Merrick, Mateo Nino, Haley Wright, Tyler Rust, Liz Himsel, Brooklyn Helming, Beth Seidl, Stacy Helming, and Amanda Bell.

Tickets for Frankenstein: The Radio Play are now available for purchase on ACT’s website: https://www.actorscommunitytheatre.com/tickets.

General Admission tickets for the Thyen-Clark Cultural Center Black Box Theatre are $10.00 each, with a maximum capacity of 100 patrons per performance.

Ticket sales will take place exclusively online through ACT’s website until the evening of each performance. Any remaining tickets will be available for purchase at the door on the night of the performance, only if still available.

Performances will take place on Thursday, October 8th, Friday, October 9th, and Saturday, October 10th, 2026, beginning at 7:00 PM EST, with doors opening at 6:30 PM EST. Guests are asked to enter through Door #11 upon arrival.

The Thyen-Clark Cultural Center Black Box Theatre is located at 100 3rd Ave., Suite A, Jasper, IN 47546.

This production contains themes and situations that may not be suitable for young children. This production utilizes rapid flashing lights and strobe lighting effects.

For more information about Frankenstein: The Radio Play, visit ACT’s website at https://www.actorscommunitytheatre.com/.
